name: Liam Baker
bio:
Liam's passion for motorsport ignited early, fueled by his grandfather's stories of racing legends. Though not a driver himself, Liam found his niche in the intricate world of motorsport PR. After graduating with a degree in Communications, he landed an internship with a local racing team before securing a junior role at a larger motorsport organization. He quickly proved his mettle, crafting compelling narratives and managing media relations with surprising skill for someone so young.

Liam's approach to PR is anything but traditional. He believes in authenticity and transparency, crafting stories that resonate with fans on a deeper level. He's not afraid to push boundaries and experiment with new platforms, always seeking innovative ways to connect with audiences. His keen understanding of the digital landscape makes him a valuable asset to any team. What sets Liam apart is his ability to blend data-driven insights with creative storytelling, ensuring every campaign is both engaging and effective.

Joining Carlin represents a significant step in Liam's career. He's eager to immerse himself in the team's rich history and contribute to its future success. He's particularly excited about the opportunity to work with a diverse roster of drivers and build their personal brands, making them household names in the motorsport world.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Liam is of average height, with a lean build and an approachable demeanor.

quirks: Constantly chews on the end of his pen when brainstorming.
Always has a notebook filled with random ideas and scribbles.
Prefers to conduct meetings while walking, believing it stimulates creativity.
